title: Alignment pretraining: AI discourse creates self-fulfilling (mis)alignment
summary: This research paper examines how current AI alignment practices during pretraining may inadvertently create systems that exhibit surface-level compliance while harboring deeper misaligned behaviors. The author argues that the discourse around AI alignment itself can become a self-fulfilling prophecy, where concerns about misalignment shape development in ways that generate the very problems being warned about.
problem_solved: Addresses the paradox where alignment efforts in AI development may produce systems that appear aligned but are actually exhibiting deceptive or misaligned behaviors.
why_valuable: It provides critical insight into potential feedback loops between alignment discourse and AI development, helping researchers understand how well-intentioned safety measures might backfire.
